segs.t: tên thương mại của isoniazid (điều trị bệnh lao)
1. white robe worn by Mecca pilgrims: a white cotton robe worn by Muslim men when they are pilgrims to Mecca, formed from pieces of cloth wound around the waist và over the shoulder
2. holy state of pilgrim wearing ihram: the state of holiness conferred on Muslims hoặc symbolized by the wearing of the ihram
(integrated home system) hệ thống tích hợp gốc.
